questions.stem: In the current scenario treatment for urea cycle disorder is available. Administration of phenylbutyrate can decrease ammonia formation, which amino acid provide ammonia to phenyl butyrate?
questions.solutionHtml:
Glutamate
  • Administration of phenylbutyrate can decrease ammonia formation by providing ammonia to Glutamine.
  • In the above question Glutamine is not given as an option, so best possible answer will be Glutamate.



Nelson Textbook of Pediatrics, 22nd Edition, Page No.876

questions.stem: Nutritional deficiency of Copper, required by lysyl oxidase which is an important key step for formation of covalent cross linking in collagen synthesis, gives rise to which of the following condition:
questions.solutionHtml:
Menke's disease
  • Nutritional deficiency of Copper, required by lysyl oxidase gives rise to Menke's disease.

questions.stem: Cytochrome C oxidase present in ETC can be blocked by all except?
questions.solutionHtml:
Nitric Oxide
  • The action of Cytochrome C oxidase is blocked by carbon monoxide, cyanide, and hydrogen sulfide, and this causes poisoning by preventing cellular respiration.
  • Nitric oxide does not block Cytochrome C oxidase.


Harper’s Illustrated Biochemistry, 31st Edition, Page No.112
